agentProviderSpec.description: A compact provider selector: provider[-model[-effort]]. A plain provider id (see agentProvider) inherits the CLI's own model and effort; an optional model rides after the provider (passed to the CLI verbatim, so multi-segment ids like gpt-5-codex work); a trailing effort token (lo/low, med/medium, hi/high, xhi/xhigh, max) sets the reasoning effort. Examples: claude, codex-sol, claude-fable-hi, codex-astra-lo. A model is rejected for providers without a model flag, and effort is checked against the provider's published vocabulary when one exists.

visibility.description: Whether this workflow is offered as a choice. "internal" keeps the name out of every listing (the repo manifest, the desktop's new-task picker, the tool catalog's advertised lineup) while it still resolves when named explicitly on task creation — visibility governs listing, not access. Defaults to "public" when absent.

revision_limit.description: Agent-requested revision rounds a task may spend before Kanna stops forking revisions and parks the task for its human. Defaults to 5 when omitted; 0 disables the cap. A human-requested revision is never refused and resets the count.

revision_transition.description: Completion policy for main runs entered through a revision request. Defaults to transition when omitted.

post.description: Tail work injected into the stage's running agent session when the stage transitions forward. `agent` is the fallback spawned when the session is dead.
